chunks: And whatever was in it from Mundhir ibn Jayfar, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Mundhir ibn Jayfar.

key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: the perfumer; identifying title of Muhammad ibn Yahya
key_terms.مُنْذِرِ بْنِ جَيْفَرٍ: the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Mundhir ibn Jafar in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Mundhir ibn Jafar. It serves as a chain-of-transmission notice in hadith literature, identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and the named narrator.
